label: Locked before any v0.1.25 simulation or place-and-route. Power is needs real board. v0.1.19, v0.1.22, v0.1.23 and v0.1.24 RTL stay byte-identical. This candidate is pure pipelined K1. It is not a hybrid.

caveats_from_v0124.selector: scp4d_hybrid_pipe sets next_fsd to 0, so full scan never ran. That is not a hybrid result.
caveats_from_v0124.missing_baseline: There is no placed loop that is scp4d_ede_pipe alone, without scp4d_fsd and without a selector.
caveats_from_v0124.fmax: loop-ede-w4l8 median Fmax is 35.09634017944336 MHz. loop-k1pipe-w4l8 median Fmax is 30.498031616210938 MHz. Cycle wins and the slower clock nearly cancel in wall time.

known_critical_path: Committed fixtures/scp/v0119-pnr/loop-k1pipe-w4l8/45F-route-seed1.report.json. The seed-1 path starts at dec.ph and ends at dec.fe.tq[4]. Sum of hop delays is 32.78899972140789 ns, which is that seed's 30.498031616210938 MHz. The path is routing-dominated and sits in scp4d_tdec_s_w4_bram. The cut for the candidate follows wrap_loop_k1bare's median-seed report if that path is in a different module. The seed-1 decoder path is the expected target.

metric.name: held-out wall time
metric.fmax: That design's own five-seed 45F median Fmax. One netlist, used at every width.
metric.cycles: Icarus wall cycles of that named wrapper on the held-out grid at that ADDR_W. RTL parameter ADDR_W is 11. cfg_D is the workload D.
metric.workload: The v0.1.24 held-out grids: seed 9, T=64, 16 frames each of low, medium, high, very_high. Not a new workload.

strongest_k1: At each ADDR_W, the smaller wall time of loop-k1bare-w4l8 and the old K1 reference.

candidate.rule: Same decision records as scp4d_ede_pipe. One register cut, in a new copy of the module that owns wrap_loop_k1bare's critical path at the median-Fmax seed. v0.1.22, v0.1.23 and v0.1.24 sources are not edited. One cut, one simulation, one place-and-route.

selector: None. No threshold is fit. A hybrid that must run both engines is not this candidate. The committed profile shows a blocking full scan is slower than K1 in this closed loop at every churn band. Calling a pure pipelined-K1 result a hybrid win is a FAIL of the label, even if the wall time wins.
wall_PASS: Candidate wall time is strictly less than the smaller of strongest K1 and the full-scan loop at every required width.
bit_exact_PASS: The candidate's decision-change set matches the shared-state golden for an ede engine on that grid. Order inside a frame may follow the tap. The full-scan baseline is checked against the full-scan golden. The bare pipe is checked against the ede golden.

fit.PASS: All five 45F seeds of that design route within 7200 s.
fit.flags: OSS CAD Suite 20261118, Yosys 0.71+50 583f380c6, nextpnr-ecp5 0.11.1-103-ge811ba48, router2, seeds 1-5, --45k CABGA381, --freq 12, --timing-allow-fail. Serial. No parallel nextpnr.
record: critical path of the bare pipe and of the candidate

per_lut_expectation: The loop contains the codec. Decisions/s per LUT uses (evals/cycles) * median Fmax_MHz * 1e6 / TRELLIS_COMB on the ADDR_W 12 grid. Standalone full scan in the committed benchmark is 71397.91807427029. v0.1.24's placed pipe is 150.30925359248772. A faster clock raises the loop's number and it is still expected to lose to standalone full scan by a wide margin. That loss is not a FAIL. The v0.1.21 sweep stays FAIL.

verdict.PASS: wall_PASS and bit_exact_PASS and fit PASS for the candidate, and the result is labeled pure pipelined K1 with zero full-scan frames.
verdict.STOP: Bit-exact, at least three 45F seeds route, and at least one width does not strictly beat min(strongest K1, full-scan loop). Report the measured wall times and stop. No second cut.
verdict.FAIL: Decision records do not match, or fewer than three candidate seeds route, or a pure pipelined-K1 result is labeled a hybrid win.

stop: One candidate. If it does not PASS, report the best wall times of the candidate, the bare pipe, the old K1 reference and the full-scan loop, and stop. Do not tune a selector on this held-out set. Do not add another pipeline cut after seeing the wall times.
